name: VitaSDR
description: A PS Vita homebrew client for web SDR receivers.
long_description: A PS Vita homebrew client for web SDR receivers. Point it at a KiwiSDR or an OpenWebRX receiver and it streams the audio, tunes it, and shows a live RF waterfall — a shortwave/HF (and, via OpenWebRX, VHF) radio in your hands, using someone else's antenna over the internet.
